hypothesis: W-R41 showed lag2 XOR-invariant temporal features preserve most matched-pair distinguishing information (only 8.449% exact pair collisions) despite poor W-R40 linear readout accuracy. Test whether a small nonlinear depth-2 axis-aligned decision-tree head trained on new development data outperforms a linear perceptron on exact same lag2 features under the same observation/training-example budget, while disclosing differing hypothesis classes and search cost.
freeze: Freeze new dev2032..2047, sealed heldout2048..2063, three generator families, two swap sites, 4-bit quantizer, identity-only dev and identity/XOR55 heldout, 16 lag2 invariant inputs. Train 16-weight+bias linear perceptron 32 epochs LR0.1, and depth-2 greedy CART-style tree with fixed 0..32 integer split thresholds, index0..15, deterministic tie-breaking; no post-evaluation search, threshold changes or tuning.

training.tree_greedy_fit: optimize root in-sample accuracy then separate child splits using same development examples only, deterministic ties first smallest index/threshold

measure: For each arm/encoding/generator/site/seed report balanced TP/TN/FP/FN, distinct raw observational positives and negatives, exact feature collision count, training objective/updates, model size and threshold search candidate/evaluated examples. Tree requires greater data-dependent combinatorial search; identical training examples and input width do NOT establish equivalent compute or function class.
classification: NONLINEAR_READOUT_GAIN iff tree heldout accuracy >=0.65 on identity and XOR55 and improves linear heldout by >=0.10; PARTIAL_GAIN iff tree improves >=0.05; NO_GAIN otherwise. Preserve failures/overfitting and expose nondeployable exact-label upper bound from previous W-R41 only as historical context (no fresh holdout label usage to fit).
controls: No changes to raw candidate encoding, label allocation, future observations, model inputs, training-data volume or sensors
Training order identical for both arms, labels only for development training, no sealed sample used for branch selection
Numerical parameter count tree <=10 split/leaf constants vs linear17 weights+bias, but training compute and hypothesis class differ; do not claim equal compute or equal assurance
One original immutable first-use archive before one required full Go regression/build; no accepted-ref mutation, runtime or production authority
claim_limit: Synthetic 4-bit lag2 temporal bit-XOR features and bounded nonlinear readout, not learned general language representation or equal-training-compute result.
